subject: Outage of Dynamic Bridge - Bras d'Or Lakes
text:
Outage of Dynamic Bridge - Bras d'Or Lakes
The Barra Strait bridge at 45 57.583N 060 47.941W will be unable to lift, except in case of emergency, from 031500 UTC until 032000 UTC Nov 2026 due to diving operations and hauling of conduit for submarine cable in the channel.
